meta.source: DESIGN.md (style reference only) — mobile WebView event page, 390px, light only

color.note: Names mirror the dot path: color.bg.canvas → color-bg-canvas → var(--color-bg-canvas). Light theme only.

tokens.name: color-bg-canvas
tokens.usage: color.bg.canvas — the page background under every card. Warm cream, never pure white.

tokens.name: color-bg-surface
tokens.usage: color.bg.surface — CouponCard and Modal fill.

tokens.name: color-bg-banner
tokens.usage: color.bg.banner — Banner fill, bleeding into the top safe area. Only text-on-dark tokens go on it.

tokens.name: color-bg-overlay
tokens.usage: color.bg.overlay — dim layer behind the Modal, covering the whole viewport including safe areas.

tokens.name: color-action-primary
tokens.usage: color.action.primary — primary button fill ('쿠폰 받기', '닫기'), outlined button border and label. 5.8:1 against white.

tokens.name: color-action-on-primary
tokens.usage: color.action.onPrimary — label on a color-action-primary fill.

tokens.name: color-action-disabled
tokens.usage: color.action.disabled — fill of a disabled button ('받기 완료'). No border.

tokens.name: color-action-on-disabled
tokens.usage: color.action.onDisabled — label on color-action-disabled. Kept readable (≈5:1) because '받기 완료' is a status, not a dead control.

tokens.name: color-text-accent
tokens.usage: color.text.accent — heading emphasis: the discount number and modal title. On surface 7.4:1, on canvas 6.5:1.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: color.text.primary — coupon name, body copy, section labels on surface or canvas.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: color.text.secondary — captions, metadata, validity dates on surface or canvas (≥5:1).

tokens.name: color-text-on-dark
tokens.usage: color.text.onDark — banner title on color-bg-banner.

tokens.name: color-text-on-dark-secondary
tokens.usage: color.text.onDarkSecondary — banner supporting line on color-bg-banner (≈7:1).

tokens.name: color-border-divider
tokens.usage: color.border.divider — the one hairline between the modal's sections. Decorative; never the only separator of meaning.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: color.focus.ring — 2px keyboard/accessibility-focus outline, offset 2px, on every surface.

families.sans: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Five steps, all -0.01em. Hierarchy comes from weight + color first: card title and body share 16px and differ only by 600 vs 400.

styles.name: text-banner-title
styles.usage: Banner title only, in color-text-on-dark. Max two lines.

styles.name: text-discount
styles.usage: The discount number on CouponCard, in color-text-accent. Numbers and % only — never sentences.

styles.name: text-card-title
styles.usage: Coupon name, modal title, button labels. color-text-primary (modal title: color-text-accent).

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Modal conditions, any running copy. color-text-primary.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Card metadata, section labels in the modal, banner supporting line. color-text-secondary (on banner: color-text-on-dark-secondary).

spacing.note: Five steps only: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24. Screen gutter is 16px.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between discount number and coupon name.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the two buttons on a card; between banner title and its supporting line.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between stacked CouponCards; between a modal section label and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: CouponCard padding; gap between card text block and button row.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Modal padding; banner vertical padding; space between banner and the first card; page bottom padding before the safe area.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Screen left/right margin for every block. Banner content uses it too, while its fill runs edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: CouponCard and Modal corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button. No square buttons.

shadow.note: Two levels, each a stack of low-alpha layers — never one heavy drop.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: CouponCard at rest on the canvas: a whisper of lift.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialog floating over the dim overlay.

safeArea.note: Full-screen WebView: the page draws under the status bar and home indicator. Needs <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">. If the native side injects insets itself, it overrides these two custom properties on :root.

tokens.name: safe-area-top
tokens.usage: Added to the Banner's top padding (space-24 + safe-area-top). The banner fill runs behind the status bar.

tokens.name: safe-area-bottom
tokens.usage: Added to the page's bottom padding (space-24 + safe-area-bottom) and to the Modal's vertical limit.

tokens.name: size-viewport
tokens.usage: Reference design width. Layouts stay fluid; nothing is fixed to this width.

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable control (buttons, modal close).

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: transform: scale() on :active for every button — the signature press.

tokens.name: press-duration
tokens.usage: Transition time for press scale and color changes (ease).
